collection: SHADDAI Roster · The Lantern Order + The Seven Agents
spine: Cinematic occult-almanac sci-fi, ancient sacred wisdom fused with future technology. Obsidian-black, luminous emerald, illuminated-manuscript gold.
note: 12 characters total: 5 Lantern Order roster (shared chibi scale, uniform emerald-glow identity) + 7 SHADDAI council agents (each keeps their own established proportions/accent color per agent, NOT forced into chibi uniformity -- NEXUS is a full-size mech, ZEROX/ORACLE/QUILL are slender human proportions, SHADDAI/TURTLE/PIKADON are chibi). 3D rig + matching 2D sprite sheet per character in fal-assets/characters/<name>/.

characters.name: The Warrior
characters.bio: The order's shield-line. Armor scarred by close work, cape cut short so it never catches underfoot. Doesn't chase a fight — just stands where the fight has to go through.

characters.name: The Mage
characters.bio: Keeps the order's older knowledge alive — the kind written before anyone thought to fear it. The hood isn't modesty; it's what's left of the discipline needed to hold the glow steady.

characters.name: The Explorer
characters.bio: First through every door the order hasn't mapped yet. The grapple line has more hours on it than the sword ever will — most of this job is getting somewhere, not fighting once you're there.

characters.name: The Engineer
characters.bio: Keeps the order's machinery — and the order itself — running. The wrench is a tool first, a weapon only when someone forces the point.

characters.name: The Scout
characters.bio: Says less than anyone in the order and needs to. By the time you've noticed the scout, the shot's already been lined up for longer than you'd like.

characters.name: SHADDAI
characters.silhouette: Chibi, crowned, winged, gold-trimmed black armor
characters.bio: Coordinates every other agent and makes the final call. The crown and wings aren't decoration — nobody else in the council outranks this seat.

characters.name: NEXUS
characters.bio: Backend and infrastructure, built like it looks — heavy, load-bearing, no wasted motion.

characters.name: ZEROX
characters.silhouette: Slim adult proportions, blocky head, business suit + cape
characters.bio: Billing, pricing, unit economics. Always closing.

characters.name: ORACLE
characters.bio: Gathers context before anyone else acts on it. Curious to a fault.

characters.name: TURTLE
characters.bio: Designs the experience everyone else just uses. Cares about feel over flash.

characters.name: QUILL
characters.silhouette: Slender young scribe, scroll on back
characters.bio: Writes the words the rest of the council gets credit for.

characters.name: PIKADON
characters.silhouette: Stocky chibi guardian, horned helm, shield on back
characters.bio: Guard rails, audit trails, worst-case assumptions. The shield is always up.
